package runtime_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/floegence/floret/v7/config"
	"github.com/floegence/floret/v7/florettest"
	"github.com/floegence/floret/v7/identity"
	"github.com/floegence/floret/v7/provider"
	"github.com/floegence/floret/v7/runtime"
	"github.com/floegence/floret/v7/storage"
	"github.com/floegence/floret/v7/tools"
)

// Run against the exact released writer with FIXTURE_OUTPUT naming a new file.
func TestGenerateDeepSeekRetryFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("FIXTURE_OUTPUT")
	if path == "" {
		t.Fatal("FIXTURE_OUTPUT is required")
	}
	var requests, effects atomic.Int32
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var body struct{ Input json.RawMessage }
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
		switch requests.Add(1) {
		case 1:
			fmt.Fprint(w, "data: {\"type\":\"response.reasoning_text.delta\",\"delta\":\"Released writer retained reasoning.\"}\n\n")
			fmt.Fprint(w, "data: {\"type\":\"response.failed\",\"response\":{\"id\":\"failed\",\"error\":{\"code\":\"fixture_failure\",\"message\":\"fixture failure\"}}}\n\n")
		case 2:
			if !strings.Contains(string(body.Input), "Released writer retained reasoning.") {
				t.Error("Retry lost reasoning")
			}
			fmt.Fprint(w, "data: {\"type\":\"response.completed\",\"response\":{\"id\":\"call-response\",\"status\":\"completed\",\"output\":[{\"type\":\"function_call\",\"id\":\"item\",\"call_id\":\"confirmed-call\",\"name\":\"write\",\"arguments\":\"{}\"}]}}\n\n")
		default:
			t.Error("old writer unexpectedly sent a third request")
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	gateway, err := provider.NewDeepSeek(provider.DeepSeekOptions{Model: "deepseek-flash", BaseURL: server.URL, APIKey: "fixture", StateCompatibilityKey: "fixture:v7.107.2"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write := tools.Define[struct{}](tools.Definition{Name: "write", InputSchema: tools.StrictObject(nil, nil), Permission: tools.PermissionSpec{Mode: tools.PermissionAllow}}, nil, nil, func(context.Context, tools.Invocation[struct{}]) (tools.Result, error) {
		effects.Add(1)
		return tools.Result{Text: "CONFIRMED_RELEASED_WRITE"}, nil
	})
	gate := runtime.EffectAuthorizationGateFunc(func(ctx context.Context, request runtime.EffectAuthorizationRequest, effect runtime.AuthorizedEffect) (runtime.EffectDispatchResult, error) {
		return effect(ctx, runtime.EffectAuthorizationProof{EffectAttemptID: request.EffectAttemptID, RequestFingerprint: request.RequestFingerprint, ThreadID: request.ThreadID, TurnID: request.TurnID, RunID: request.RunID, ToolCallID: request.ToolCallID, PolicyRevision: "test", AuditReference: "test", AuditHash: "test", AuthorizedAt: time.Now()})
	})
	agent, err := runtime.NewAgent(config.AgentConfig{Profile: config.AgentProfile{ID: "fixture", Name: "Fixture"}, SystemPrompt: "Write once.", Context: config.ContextPolicy{ContextWindowTokens: 128000}}, gateway, runtime.WithAgentTools(write), runtime.WithAgentEffectAuthorization(gate), runtime.WithAgentProviderRetryPolicy(runtime.ProviderRetryPolicy{Disabled: true}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	host, err := runtime.Open(t.Context(), runtime.Options{Storage: storage.SQLite(path), IDSource: florettest.NewIDSource(florettest.IDSourceOptions{ThreadIDs: []identity.ThreadID{"fixture", "fixture-fork"}, TurnIDs: []identity.TurnID{"fixture-turn"}, RunIDs: []identity.RunID{"fixture-run"}})})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer host.Shutdown(context.Background())
	service, err := host.ThreadService(runtime.AgentFactoryFunc(func(context.Context, runtime.AgentRequest) (*runtime.Agent, error) { return agent, nil }))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	created, err := service.Create(t.Context(), runtime.CreateThreadInput{RequestKey: "create"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wait := func(id identity.ThreadID) runtime.ThreadView {
		t.Helper()
		waited, err := service.(runtime.ThreadWaiter).WaitThreads(t.Context(), runtime.WaitThreadsInput{ThreadIDs: []identity.ThreadID{id}, Timeout: time.Minute})
		if err != nil || waited.Reason != runtime.ThreadWaitCompleted {
			t.Fatalf("wait=%+v err=%v", waited, err)
		}
		view, err := service.View(t.Context(), id)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return view
	}
	if _, err := service.Send(t.Context(), runtime.SendInput{ThreadID: created.ThreadID, RequestKey: "send", Input: runtime.UserInput{Text: "Write once."}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	first := wait(created.ThreadID)
	if first.Failure == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing initial failure")
	}
	if _, err := service.Retry(t.Context(), runtime.RetryInput{ThreadID: created.ThreadID, SourceTurnID: first.TurnID, RequestKey: "retry"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	failed := wait(created.ThreadID)
	if failed.Failure == nil || !strings.Contains(failed.Failure.Message, "DeepSeek response history does not match canonical context") || requests.Load() != 2 || effects.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected old writer state: failure=%+v requests=%d effects=%d", failed.Failure, requests.Load(), effects.Load())
	}
	if _, err := service.Fork(t.Context(), runtime.ForkThreadInput{SourceThreadID: created.ThreadID, RequestKey: "fork"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := host.Shutdown(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
